profile.name: IQ波形文件转换工具
profile.description: 用于读写和打包 IQW、WV、IQ.tar 等 IQ 基带波形文件的软件工具，常用于实验室中矢量信号发生器或其他射频仪器的离线波形准备、数据交换与文件格式转换。
profile.description_en: A software utility for reading, writing, and packaging IQ baseband waveform files such as IQW, WV, and IQ.tar. It is commonly used in laboratories for offline waveform preparation, data exchange, and file format conversion for vector signal generators and related RF instruments.

registry.name: Zurich Instruments IQ Demodulator
registry.description: Zurich Instruments IQ Demodulator是一款实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括写入数据、读取数据。支持Signal, Slot, dataConvert等操作。
